note: FROZEN VINTAGE. The exporters read these values VERBATIM; nothing recomputes them at export time, so a board can show a same-day 1-year value beside a 3-year value frozen earlier. Three blocks because the three anchor pools are three separate metrics.

hit.definition: PA-weighted mean WAR/PA+ over the trailing 3 seasons. Steadier than one season because a WAR rate carries fielding and baserunning on top of the bat or the arm. tag is 'established' with 2+ seasons and 600 PA in the window, otherwise 'provisional'.

sp.definition: IP-weighted mean WAR/IP+ (starter pool) over the trailing 3 seasons. Steadier than one season because a WAR rate carries fielding and baserunning on top of the bat or the arm. tag is 'established' with 2+ seasons and 120 IP in the window, otherwise 'provisional'.

rp.definition: IP-weighted mean WAR/IP+ (reliever pool) over the trailing 3 seasons. Steadier than one season because a WAR rate carries fielding and baserunning on top of the bat or the arm. tag is 'established' with 2+ seasons and 40 IP in the window, otherwise 'provisional'.
